notes.title: 🚀 Spice Trade Update: New Game Launcher Added!
notes.notes:
[h2]🚀 [b]Update: Spice Trade Gets a Launcher![/b] 🚀[/h2][p]Hello Spice Traders!
We’ve just rolled out a new [b]game launcher[/b] for Spice Trade. 🎉[/p][p]With the launcher, you can:[/p][list][*][p]Access the game more smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p]Get notified about updates and patches.[/p][/*][*][p]See quick links to our community spaces and future projects here on Steam.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s a small step, but it makes the experience cleaner and keeps you connected to what’s next.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🍕 [b]Speaking of what’s next…[/b]
We’re excited to also share that our next release is on the horizon: [b]Pizza Syndicate[/b]! A cult-classic tycoon from the ’90s, brought back to modern systems. Manage restaurants, hire staff, sabotage rivals, and build your pizza empire with humor and strategy.[/p][p]👉 Check it out and [b]wishlist Pizza Syndicate today[/b] to support the comeback!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4004630/Pizza_Syndicate/"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for playing [b]Spice Trade[/b] and being part of the community—we’re cooking up more for you soon, both in spices… and pizza. 😉
